approved_payload.content: Police say they responded to a complaint of a residential burglary in progress at about 04:00 on Tuesday 13 October at Malope Section in the Masemola policing area, Sekhukhune District. They found an adult man lying on the floor with visible injuries; he was unresponsive and was later declared dead. Police say he was allegedly apprehended by people who suspected him of being involved in a burglary at the residence; the circumstances of his death are under investigation. Two suspects, aged 29 and 32, were arrested and charged with murder, due in the Nebo Magistrate's Court on 15 October (SAPS, on X, 14 October). The man is not named here. One source: the police post itself; no news report found. The pin is approximate: a wide town-level point for Ga-Masemola, not the scene.
